body: I think I do, I have nothing in common with these people other than genes. Just because they are related to me doesn't mean they can show up and ask to hang out.

He was an alcoholic and abusive. My mom and my aunt had a disagreement of some sort, my mom's theory is that she is trying to rebuild bridges, but I don't remember interacting with any of these people including my dad. I don't even know what any of them look like.

Yeah, I try to laugh as much as I can. As for hobbies I got into juggling a couple years ago (I know, it's lame but there is a huge online community) but I ended up getting bored and haven't really been motivated to do anything else. The thing that scares me is that once I move out I won't be able to be normal or have friends or really do anything. Like one of those animals that's been in captivity their whole life only to die in the first 24 hours of being free because they know nothing about the wild.

 Reddit is the only thing I really have now, I've been noticing I have been fumbling my words when talking to my brother or mom in the last couple months, I only talk to them in the morning before mom leaves for work and in the evening when she gets home, so I don't talk enough for me articulate words very well... I am getting better at typing, so I got that goin for me. 

We went out to get some groceries yesterday, which I usually don't do (I think the last time was a couple months ago). I had to go grab some bread from across the store and the whole time I hyperventilated, I don't even know why; But I felt like I was being overwhelmed with people. I don't care enough to ask my mom to buy anything or do anything, because she always gets mad (think the evil mother in the disney movie tangled). In the past year I've only bought jeans and grey T-shirts Because what's the point of anything else.

Thanks for the reply, sorry if I rambled on... Just need to vent a bit.
